Name: Owner Squeeze Cascade
Pathway: Revenue decline → Margin compression → Owner compensation cut → Personal savings depletion → Personal credit stress → Consumer deterioration
Mechanism: Owners absorb early stress personally; cut own pay before employees; use personal savings for business; personal credit suffers

Name: Employment Transmission Cascade
Pathway: Business stress → Hiring freeze → Hour cuts → Layoffs → Local unemployment spike → Consumer spending decline → Further business stress
Mechanism: Small businesses employ ~47% of workforce; employment decisions lag stress 3-6 months; local concentration; multiplier effect
Feedback_Loops: Consumer spending decline worsens business stress

Name: Credit Contamination Cascade
Pathway: Business loan delinquency → Personal guarantee called → Owner personal default → Consumer credit deterioration → Reduced consumer credit access
Mechanism: Most SB loans require personal guarantees; business default = personal default; credit score destruction; loss of consumer credit access

Name: Local Multiplier Collapse
Pathway: Small business closures → Lost local wages → Reduced local spending → Neighboring business stress → Accelerated local closure wave
Mechanism: SBs buy from local businesses; employees spend locally; closure removes both spending streams; contagion within geographic area
Breakpoint: Multiple closures in same commercial district

Name: Franchise Failure Wave
Pathway: Franchisor squeeze on terms → Franchisee margin collapse → Franchisee defaults → Personal guarantee destruction → Franchisee becomes distressed consumer
Mechanism: Franchise agreements require significant personal investment; personal guarantees on buildout loans; franchisor can tighten terms; concentrated risk
Breakpoint: Major franchise system reports elevated franchisee failures
